highlights.title: Qwen3.8-27B runs frontier-class coding agents and reasoning locally, no cloud API required
highlights.description: The biggest AI model release of the past few days, at least among the developers and AI power users on social media, wasn't a frontier cloud model from OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. It was a 27-billion-parameter model from Alibaba: Qwen3.8-27B landed on Hugging Face on Friday under an enterprise-friendly, open source Apache 2.0 license, giving developers downloadable weights for a dense multimodal model. But Qwen3.8-27B isn't a garden variety small local model: it includes native image and video

highlights.title: Apple: DOJ’s latest challenge in antitrust case ‘fails at every level’
highlights.description: Apple is pushing back against the Department of Justice’s bid to overturn a court decision allowing the company to seek documents from more than a dozen federal agencies. Here are the details.

highlights.title: Tesla grows Robotaxi fleet by 50%, Einride gets a partner, and China goes BIG
highlights.description: On this second consecutive self-steering episode of Quick Charge, we take a look at how Tesla increased its national self-driving Robotaxi fleet by half with the stroke of a pen, and see how the company’s autonomous deployments compare to the rest of the world’s.

highlights.title: Xiaomi Earnings Key to Extending Stock’s Best Rally In a Year
highlights.description: Xiaomi Corp. shares may extend their best quarterly performance in over a year if its earnings report shows it’s gotten a handle on rising material expenses.

highlights.title: China Axing Microsoft Windows From State Users Ahead of Plan
highlights.description: China is pulling the plug on an older version of Microsoft Corp.’s Windows tailored for government agencies, taking another step toward rooting out the world’s most popular PC software in a broader effort to reduce its dependence on foreign technology.

highlights.title: Korea Denies Report on Discussing Chips as First US Investment
highlights.description: South Korea denied a local media report that the government is discussing a semiconductor project as the first investment under its $350 billion commitment to the US.

highlights.title: Microsoft MVP creates site to remind you of all the brands Redmond replaced
highlights.description: If you’re still talking about ‘DirSync’ or ‘Active Directory’ instead of ‘Entra’, and need to explain why, this is the site for you

highlights.title: Tesla’s Cybercab is about to launch — and we don’t get it
highlights.description: Tesla has told employees it is preparing a public launch of the Cybercab in Austin as soon as this month, according to a report from The Information. It would be the first Tesla vehicle ever built without a steering wheel or pedals — and the least exciting vehicle the company has ever made, because it is virtually worthless without an autonomous driving system Tesla still hasn’t delivered at scale.

highlights.title: Apple's Camera-Equipped AirPods Confirmed: See Them in Action
highlights.description: Apple is working on camera-equipped AirPods that appear to be nearly ready to launch, based on a video MacRumors found in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate. In a short demo, a man holds a book up so the camera in the AirPods can see the title. "With Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? Just ask me to save it for later," says the voiceover text. Here is your first look at AirPods with Cameras in action using Visual Intelligence. This video file came from m

highlights.title: AirPods with cameras get their clearest leak yet
highlights.description: Included in today’s macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate is a short video that appears to show Visual Intelligence in action on Apple’s rumored camera-equipped AirPods. Watch it below.
